domains.description: Experimental mgbrowser CDP subset. This schema describes only implemented research-browser behavior, not Chrome or full CDP compatibility.

commands.name: getVersion
commands.description: Report mgbrowser identity and the bundled experimental interpreter version. This does not imply scripting is enabled or the Runtime domain is implemented.

domains.description: One page target. Browser connections can attach using flattened sessions; no target creation, workers, or browser contexts.

commands.name: getTargets
commands.description: Return the sole available page; target filters are unsupported.

commands.name: attachToTarget
commands.description: Attach to the existing page. This subset requires flatten=true; nested message sessions are unsupported.

domains.description: Single-frame navigation and software-rendered viewport inspection. Browser toolbar and status strip are excluded; scale is fixed at one.

types.description: Core committed-frame metadata for the sole top-level frame; experimental Chrome security and isolation metadata is not supplied.

properties.name: url
properties.description: Committed document URL without its fragment.

properties.name: urlFragment
properties.description: Fragment including the leading #, when present.

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Enable Page notifications for this connection or session.

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Disable Page notifications for this connection or session.

commands.name: navigate
commands.description: Navigate to an absolute HTTP(S) URL of at most 16 KiB. The response waits for navigation completion; transport failure or supersession produces errorText. frameId, when present, must be frame-1.

commands.name: reload
commands.description: Reload using existing browser navigation. No script injection or cache implementation is provided.

commands.name: getLayoutMetrics
commands.description: Page viewport geometry at scale one. Deprecated device-pixel fields equal CSS-pixel fields in this implementation.

commands.name: captureScreenshot
commands.description: Return a base64 PNG of the current page viewport. format defaults to png; other codecs, clip, and captureBeyondViewport=true are unsupported. Both fromSurface values use the same software raster. No scaling or full-page capture. Encoded output is limited to 7 MiB.

domains.description: Inspection of mgbrowser's actual bounded HTML tree. Selectors are a declared subset. Node references are invalidated by document replacement or accepted script-event projection; Runtime object handles are unsupported.

types.description: Eight values describing four x,y corners.

commands.name: getDocument
commands.description: Read the parser tree and enable documentUpdated events. depth defaults to one, accepts 0..256, and -1 requests the bounded subtree. pierce=true is unsupported. Serialized root is limited to 4 MiB.

commands.name: querySelector
commands.description: Query the supported selector subset within the requested node. A missing match returns nodeId zero.

commands.name: getBoxModel
commands.description: Union of this node's own or descendant flow boxes, with viewport intersection required. The four model quads are currently equal and may extend outside the viewport. Wholly offscreen/non-rendered nodes, layout collections reaching 100000 rectangles, and queries exceeding four million traversal steps return an error without a partial model. This is not a full CSS box model.

commands.name: focus
commands.description: Focus an editable control represented by nodeId. Other node-handle forms are unsupported.

events.name: documentUpdated
events.description: Document replaced or script-event projection accepted; discard previous nodeId references and request the new root.

domains.description: Input for the existing page controls, using CSS viewport coordinates and fixed scale one. With opt-in scripting, activation dispatches bounded retained click/submit handlers. No touch, drag, IME composition, synthetic script dispatch, or general keyboard/input event support.

commands.name: dispatchMouseEvent
commands.description: Basic left click and vertical wheel input within the page viewport. Press/release require button:left; buttons and clickCount are limited to 0 or 1, modifiers to zero, deltaX to zero, and absolute deltaY to at most 100000. A release within five pixels of its session's press activates once. Mouse movement has no hover/drag behavior.

commands.name: dispatchKeyEvent
commands.description: Page keys: Enter, Backspace, Tab, PageUp/Down, ArrowUp/Down, Shift, Control, or one character. Only Ctrl=2 and Shift=8 modifier bits are supported, and Ctrl+A is the sole control shortcut. windowsVirtualKeyCode fallback handles 13, 8, and 9; code, nativeVirtualKeyCode, unmodifiedText, and autoRepeat are validated metadata, not alternative key translation. Editing-command arrays are unsupported. Text insertion requires focused input, printable text, and a resulting value of at most 8191 UTF-8 bytes; rejection preserves the value and selection. rawKeyDown does not insert printable text, and keyUp has no edit action.

commands.name: insertText
commands.description: Insert printable UTF-8 text into the focused editable page control. The resulting value must be at most 8191 UTF-8 bytes, accounting for selected text replacement. Invalid text or excess size returns an error without changing value or selection.
